name: Chicken Broccoli Rice Casserole

components.name: Chicken Broccoli Rice Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 190 C. Pre-cook dry rice in stock until barely tender; it will continue absorbing moisture in the casserole.
Dice the raw chicken into even pieces. Sauté chicken briefly with oil, onion, mushroom and garlic until the outside is lightly coloured.
Blanch or steam broccoli for only 2-3 minutes, then drain to avoid excess water in the casserole.
Mix partly cooked rice, chicken mixture and broccoli in a large baking dish. Stir milk and yogurt with seasonings and spoon evenly through the mixture.
Sprinkle mozzarella over the top. Bake 25-35 minutes until the casserole is steaming throughout, rice is fully cooked and chicken is at least 74 C.
Rest 10 minutes before dividing into six portions. Pack shallowly and cool quickly; freeze later-week portions.

IMPORTANT: This is an ORIGINAL UNHANGRY rice casserole adaptation, not Lisa Bryan’s published Whole30 dish. Downshiftology version uses cooked shredded chicken, mushrooms, broccoli and a cashew alfredo but NO RICE. Source used only for inspiration; all quantities and steps here are UNHANGRY-developed.
Planning: Secondary stovetop for partly cooking rice and briefly sautéing ingredients. Requires kitchen testing of liquid-to-rice ratio.
Freezer: sauce may be slightly grainy and broccoli softer after thawing
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.

When a recipe includes rice, cool it rapidly and store cold immediately; avoid leaving cooked rice at room temperature.
Freeze in suitable airtight food-safe containers. Defrost in refrigerator, not on counter. Reheat crisp foods in oven when possible.
